Class RTFDocument

Namespace
RTFExporter
Assembly
RTFExporter.dll

Represents a Rich Text Format (RTF) document. Acts as the root container for paragraphs, color tables, font tables, and document metadata.

public class RTFDocument : IDisposable

Remarks

Implements IDisposable to facilitate automatic saving and stream cleanup when used inside a using block.
